scope: Readonly SynthConfig alphabet contract investigation; no confirmed defect and no policy change.

root_review.disposition: Do not extend RecognizerConfig scalar rejection to SynthConfig without an established supported-input failure or explicit helper contract. No confirmed product defect.

facts.observation: Synth configuration documents nonempty, nonrepeating alphabets and numeric validation; it does not declare a scalar-value policy.
Synthesize validates text rune membership in the alphabet.
Generate draws rune entries, converts the slice to string, and then invokes Synthesize.
RecognizerConfig explicitly requires Unicode scalar values and calls utf8.ValidRune.
The accepted constructor/persistence fix covers OCR/ASR recognizers, without declaring a SynthConfig scalar policy.

root_review.static_inference: Invalid rune to string conversion can produce U+FFFD; an invalid-only alphabet then reaches a membership error, while an alphabet also containing U+FFFD can fold the drawn symbol. No runtime probe was run.
